titles: The Lighthouse Keeper Who Vanished Without a Trace
Three Men Disappeared From This Island. Nobody Knows Why.
hook: In December of 1900, a supply ship arrived at a remote Scottish lighthouse. The lamp was dark. The door was unlocked. And all three keepers were gone.

scenes.title: The landing
scenes.narration: Joseph Moore was the first man ashore. He climbed the steep steps from the landing, calling out names that nobody answered.

scenes.narration: Inside, the clocks had stopped. The beds were unmade. One chair lay on its side, as if someone had stood up in a hurry.

scenes.title: The logbook
scenes.narration: Then they found the logbook. The final entries, written by Thomas Marshall, described a storm so violent that grown men wept. But on the mainland, twenty miles away, no storm was ever recorded.

scenes.narration: More than a century later, the three men have never been found. If you want more mysteries like this one, subscribe, and tell me in the comments what you think really happened.

description:
Three lighthouse keepers vanished from the Flannan Isles in 1900, leaving behind a stopped clock and a logbook nobody can explain.

In this video we walk through what the relief crew found, what the final entries said, and the theories that have been argued over ever since.
